title: The Treasury Market Practices Group: Creation and Early Initiatives - FEDERAL RESERVE BANK of NEW YORK

source.name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

summary: This Staff Report (Number 822) by Kenneth D. Garbade and Frank M. Keane examines the creation and early initiatives of the Treasury Market Practices Group (TMPG), a voluntary association of market participants that recommends trading norms for U.S. government securities. The report notes that the TMPG has no statutory authority and its recommendations carry weight through the cachet of respected market participants rather than legal force.
key_points: TMPG is a voluntary association of market participants without direct or indirect statutory authority
TMPG recommendations do not have the force of law
Recommendations target behaviors that are widely acknowledged to impinge on market liquidity
Recommendations risk damaging the reputation of the market if not followed
Authors are Kenneth D. Garbade and Frank M. Keane
